Specification: This module defines additional utility operators for bags (multisets) represented as functions from elements to positive natural multiplicities. It extends the standard Bags, Integers, and Folds modules with purely functional operators for adding one occurrence of an element, removing one occurrence, removing all occurrences, mapping and folding over bag contents, and computing bag sums and products. The module is state-free: it declares no constants or variables, no actions, and no temporal properties.
